events.title: Children's Yoga & Mindfulness Winter Workshop
events.desc: A Christmas holidays morning of yoga, breathwork, story and craft, with a snack and drink. Led by Breda, a primary school teacher and children's yoga teacher, from Luce Yoga & Wellness. Book at info@lucewellness.ie or 085 188 3127.
